walkers.name: Priyanka
walkers.about: Friendly and dependable dog walker with experience caring for energetic, senior, and rescue dogs. I focus on safe routes, patient handling, and regular updates for every pet parent.

reviews.name: Charan K.
reviews.text: Priyanka was punctual, caring, and kept us updated throughout the walk.

reviews.name: Riddhi S.
reviews.text: Sheru returned happy and relaxed. We will definitely book again.

walkers.name: Shubham Bhardwaj
walkers.about: Calm and attentive walker who enjoys structured walks and playful exercise. I am comfortable with different breeds and always follow the pet parent's routine.

reviews.name: Mehak P.
reviews.text: Very patient with our nervous puppy and easy to communicate with.

reviews.name: Karan J.
reviews.text: Reliable service and clear updates after every walk.

walkers.name: Anshul Sharma
walkers.about: Experienced with active dogs and longer walking routes. I provide consistent exercise while keeping every walk safe, positive, and suited to the dog's energy level.

reviews.name: Dhruv D.
reviews.text: Anshul handled our high-energy dog confidently and professionally.

reviews.name: Naina V.
reviews.text: Good communication and always arrives on time.

walkers.name: Gaurav Pratap Singh
walkers.about: Patient pet lover offering relaxed neighborhood walks and active exercise sessions. I pay close attention to safety, hydration, and each dog's comfort.

reviews.name: Aditi M.
reviews.text: Gaurav was friendly and our dog enjoyed the evening walk.

reviews.name: Rohan B.
reviews.text: A good walker who followed all feeding and route instructions.

walkers.name: Aarav Chib
walkers.about: Weekend walker focused on one-on-one care and quiet routes. I work best with small and medium dogs that prefer a calm pace and extra attention.

reviews.name: Simran A.
reviews.text: Aarav was gentle with our Corgi and shared a helpful walk update.

reviews.name: Vivek N.
